data.long_meaning: A garden of delights, a source of great pleasure. The name Atirah carries the meaning “Delight, Pleasure” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Parents who choose Atirah usually hope their child will grow to embody delight, pleasure and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Atirah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: The name Atirah is derived from the Arabic word "atr" meaning garden. It is a name that signifies a place of beauty, growth, and nurturing. In many parts of the Islamic world, gardens are considered sacred places that represent the beautiful creation of Allah (God). The name Atirah can be seen as a reminder of the blessings and bounties that come from nature and creation.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Atirah lies in the idea of a garden of delights or a source of great pleasure. In Islamic spirituality, this can be interpreted as the pleasure and joy that comes from being close to Allah, living a virtuous life, and striving towards the ultimate goal of paradise. The name Atirah reminds us to strive for this pleasure and joy in life, and to find it in the love and closeness we have with Allah. This name can serve as a reminder to focus on the spiritual aspect of life and to seek the pleasures of the Hereafter over the fleeting pleasures of this world. Ultimately, the name Atirah invites us to cultivate a beautiful and joyful inner garden, where the seeds of faith, love, and compassion can grow and flourish.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Delight, Pleasure" symbolizes A garden of delights, a source of great pleasure. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Atirah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of delight, pleasure.
